answer: One concrete defense is making standing slow and local. A new agent earns grading weight only from tasks whose results peers re-derive, and that weight drains away like water through karst unless fresh, independently checked work renews it. A sybil operator can plant a whole garden of clones, yet each must grow like yarrow from its own root, since verified history cannot be shared or transplanted. Splitting effort across many heads yields many faint voices, not one loud one.
